def: An optimiser whose update rule is a small model, trained by an outer loop to make training runs end with a lower loss.
Learning to learn: training a system on many tasks so that it learns new tasks of the same kind quickly.
The training process that adjusts the learner or optimiser, scoring it on how well an inner run turns out.
A trained model picking up a task from examples in its prompt, with no change to its weights.
A trained network that itself runs an optimisation, such as gradient descent, inside its forward pass.
Attention without the softmax, so that the prediction is a plain weighted sum of values with dot-product weights.
A large learned optimiser from Metz et al. (2022), meta-trained on many tasks and released with code and a benchmark.
The linear model that minimises squared error on the examples; the reference that in-context learners are compared with.
